$description: ExifCleaner brand tokens, version 2.0. Neutral names; map them to your own system.

clean-white.$description: The ground: the page after cleaning. About 60% of a light surface.

deep-teal.$description: The wordmark and all text. A teal-black, never gray or pure black. About 20% of a light surface.

rinse.$description: Alternate sections, cards and the app’s table header. About 12% of a light surface.

exifcleaner-teal.$description: The icon field, the symbol, large accents: the color people know ExifCleaner by. About 6% of a light surface.

steady-teal.$description: Links and buttons with white text: teal that holds 4.5:1. About 2% of a light surface.

deep-teal.$description: The ground in dark mode. About 62% of a dark surface.

clean-white.$description: The wordmark and all text. About 20% of a dark surface.

tide.$description: Raised surfaces and cards. About 10% of a dark surface.

seafoam.$description: Teal for dark grounds: the symbol, links and buttons. About 8% of a dark surface.

bristle-yellow.$description: The broom head. Also stickers and merch; never text on light grounds.

band-orange.$description: The binding on the broom head, and nowhere else.

pewter.$description: Secondary text on Clean White and Rinse.

fog.$description: Secondary text on Deep Teal and Tide.

sans.$description: 700 for headlines (−2% tracking), 600 for titles; 400 text, 500 lead, 600 emphasis

mono.$description: 400 for metadata, file names and counts; 500 for emphasis

motion.$description: Brand character reference, not a UI spec: the only values the logo animation uses.

logo-sting.$description: From start to rest: wind-up from a 16° tilt to 22°, the sweep, contact at 560 ms with a 4° overshoot, one rebound, still by 900 ms.

logo-release-ease.$description: The sweep itself: a fast start and a hard deceleration into contact.

logo-sparkle-gap.$description: The right sparkle pops this long after the left one; each has its own glint.
